import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-89.6, 29.2],
    [-89.3, 29.2],
    [-89.3, 29.5],
    [-89.6, 29.5],
    [-89.6, 29.2]
]])  # Bounding box around Plaquemines-Balize Delta

start_date = '2025-01-21'
end_date = '2025-01-25'  # Exclusive end date for 21-24 range

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra Daily Snow Cover
snow_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') \
    .filterBounds(geometry) \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .select(['NDSI_Snow_Cover', 'NDSI_Snow_Cover_Algorithm_Flags_QA'])

# Check if collection has data
if snow_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("MODIS Terra: 0 images")
    # Try MODIS Aqua as fallback
    snow_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1') \
        .filterBounds(geometry) \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .select(['NDSI_Snow_Cover', 'NDSI_Snow_Cover_Algorithm_Flags_QA'])
    
    if snow_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("MODIS Aqua: 0 images")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# Get collection size
coll_size = snow_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Snow images found: {coll_size}")

# 3. Processing - Create composite with best pixels
# Mask out poor quality pixels (bit 0-3 > 0 indicates some issue)
def mask_poor_quality(img):
    qa = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover_Algorithm_Flags_QA')
    # Bits 0-3: algorithm flags, 0=best, >0=issues
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(0b1111).eq(0)  # Keep only best quality (all bits 0)
    return img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask(mask)

snow_masked = snow_col.map(mask_poor_quality)

# Create maximum composite (if snow in any day)
snow_max = snow_masked.max()

# 4. Calculate snow presence
# Get maximum snow cover value in region
stats = snow_max.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
    geometry=geometry,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
)
max_snow = stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()

# Get pixel count to check if we have valid data
count_stats = snow_max.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=geometry,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
)
pixel_count = count_stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()

print(f"Max snow cover (%): {max_snow}")
print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if pixel_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif max_snow is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif max_snow > 0:  # Any snow cover > 0% indicates presence
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
